title: Full-width budget borrow pass
statement: Let $W$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $a$ be a natural number, and let $x$ be a finite word over the schedule alphabet determined by $W$ and $a$. Choose a base configuration on input $x$, an input-head position $p$, integers $u$ and $g$, tape contents $\mu,\gamma\colon\mathbb{Z}\to\mathrm{Option}(\mathrm{OblSymbol})$, a Boolean word $w$, and a Boolean carry $c$. Starting from the setup configuration whose control state is the borrow phase with carry $c$, whose budget-head position is $1$ and budget tape is the captured clock tape of $w$, and whose unary-counter and guide heads and tapes are $u,\mu$ and $g,\gamma$, respectively, after $|w|$ steps the configuration is the setup configuration with borrow carry equal to the final carry produced by the fixed-width borrow pass on $(c,w)$, budget-head position $1+|w|$, and budget tape equal to the captured clock tape of the rewritten word. In both configurations the input position, the source tapes and their heads, the unary-counter and guide tapes and heads, and the output are those specified by the same base configuration and parameters.
hypotheses_covered: W is a finite Turing machine over Bool
x is a finite word over the schedule alphabet
integer head positions u and g
replaced:
Let $w$ be a bit word and $c$ a Boolean incoming borrow, and recall the fixed-width
borrow pass: it processes all of $w$, subtracting the incoming borrow from its
little-endian value while preserving its length, and returns an outgoing borrow flag
together with the rewritten word.  From a setup configuration in the borrow phase with
flag $c$ and budget head at cell $1$ over the captured clock tape of $w$, exactly $|w|$
steps reach the borrow phase whose flag is the outgoing borrow, with budget head at
$1+|w|$ over the captured clock tape of the rewritten word; all other tapes and heads,
and the parked input head, remain fixed.
